title: Starlark Runtime + Core Builtins + Tier Classification
description:
Implement Starlark runtime and core builtins from docs/plans/07-code-interpreter.md.

Sections: §1 (Overview), §2 (Architecture), §3 (Sandboxing), §4.1-§4.3 (Meta-tool surface, core builtins, Config), §4.7 (Tier Classification), §5.1 (Step Accounting), §5.5 (Timeout), §5.7 (Error Handling), §5.8 (Value Conversion), §6 (Package Structure)

Key deliverables:
- execute_script AgentTool factory (meta-tool entry point)
- Starlark runtime with go.starlark.net: sandbox setup, load disabled, VM thread
- Core builtins: discover(keyword), describe(tool_name), invoke(tool_name, params), log(message)
- ExecutionState tracking (steps, running totals)
- Step accounting with budget enforcement (budget_exceeded)
- Wall-clock timeout enforcement
- Tier classification via AST call-expression detection
- Config struct with all execution limits
- Value conversion: JSON ↔ Starlark ↔ Go round-trip
- ExecuteRequest/Response types
- Structured execution trace
- Unit tests for all of the above

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §5 (Seam: codeinterp ↔ tools catalog for discover/describe/invoke)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter.md §1-§6
- Test harness: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T2 (Agent Loop) + T4 (Tool Framework - for tool catalog access)
